inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. Organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, the Together Alliance event was billed as the biggest [...] The post Protesters rally in London against UK far-right rise appeared first on Digital Journal .
inputs.modified_text:
Let's be completely clear about what is happening here: the corporate media and the ruling establishment are desperately trying to sweep the deep, structural roots of this hatred under the rug. 

This Saturday in central London, we witnessed the true power of collective solidarity when tens of thousands of people took to the streets to push back against a terrifying surge of far-right extremism threatening our most vulnerable communities. This monumental mobilization by the Together Alliance—backed by hundreds of groups, trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies—is a masterclass in grassroots labor and community organizing. It proves that collective solidarity is our strongest weapon against systemic bigotry. 

This vital pushback is happening just weeks ahead of key local elections, and it comes right on the heels of one of the largest-ever far-right demonstrations Britain saw six months ago. Marginalized groups are being actively targeted by this rising tide of fascism, and staying silent is simply not an option. The working people leading this movement are demanding real institutional reform and an uncompromising stand against institutional discrimination. Solidary isn't just a buzzword; it is our only defense against fascist hate.
